h1: Custom kitchens in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: Custom kitchens in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: The furniture department of DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers custom kitchens for apartments and private homes. Choose a suitable model from our catalog, and we will prepare a price quote based on the selected configuration and the parameters of your room.

Each model can be adapted to the dimensions, layout, and specific features of your room. We can change the kitchen’s configuration, the dimensions of individual elements, the materials, colors, furniture hardware, and interior fittings.
Depending on the client’s budget and requirements, the kitchen can be fitted with materials and hardware in various price categories — from more affordable solutions to the premium level.
We also offer professional kitchen delivery and installation. At the client’s request, the kitchen can additionally be equipped with a sink, household appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers custom kitchens in Bratislava and Vienna — from model selection, individual adaptation, and cost calculation to manufacturing, outfitting, delivery, and installation.
